description:
Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d)
Mission

SimScale is a browser-based engineering simulation platform on AWS. Our infrastructure team builds and operates the shared cloud foundation that 40+ engineers across 10+ product teams rely on every day.

We enable the product teams rather than acting as gatekeepers. Product teams own their services end-to-end, including their infrastructure code, monitoring, cloud cost and first response to incidents. We give them a safe and well-documented platform, guardrails and self-service tools. Thus the teams can do routine work themselves, also in production.

You join this small team as a senior individual contributor. People management is not part of the role. As the team grows, a path to a technical lead role is possible.

Your opportunity

You will share these responsibilities with the rest of the infrastructure team:

Keeping the platform simple and reliable across our AWS accounts and networks, the public edge, Kubernetes (EKS), the service mesh (Istio), and the GitOps pipelines

Securing the platform against DDoS attacks, AI-assisted cyber-attacks, running bug-bounty programs

Evolving our architecture to support dedicated, single-tenant deployments across regions and cloud providers

Maintaining infrastructure as code in Terraform and ArgoCD, and making it easy and safe for all the teams

Operating telemetry (metrics, logs, tracing) infrastructure, helping teams define SLOs and alerts, and measure their services

Follow the money: Own the monthly reconciliation of TikTok Shop settlements, fees and affiliate commissions against our records, and close every gap.

Was uns als Arbeitgeber auszeichnet? Die kurzen Wege und die Kultur eines mittelständischen Unternehmens, verbunden mit den Möglichkeiten einer internationalen Technologiegruppe. Bei uns übernehmen Menschen Verantwortung, unterstützen sich gegenseitig und gestalten gemeinsam Lösungen, die bei unseren Kunden einen echten Unterschied machen.

SumUp builds simple, affordable financial tools that help small businesses get paid, manage their money, and grow. Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing - giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.

The Cards squad is a core part of that, owning the systems that power card issuing, lifecycle management, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe. We handle millions of card transactions every day, and we're now scaling those systems to support new product capabilities while laying the foundations for a more global, resilient platform. That's why we're growing the team and looking for a seasoned backend engineer who can take real ownership of complex, high-impact work. Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.
We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.
We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role
As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll manage and grow a large portfolio of fleet business, using data and AI to assess risk and tailor cover to each client. You’ll help us move into new segments, including emerging mobility, as we build one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. You’ll report to our Head of Motor Underwriting.
You’ll work closely with brokers, mentor junior underwriters and help shape our products, wording and processes. AI is part of the underwriting process itself: you’ll use it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, leaving your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations
We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/
Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.
Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.
Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

Qui sommes nous ?
Depuis plus de 22 ans, le groupe Dans le Noir ? fait découvrir une expérience sensorielle et humaine hors du commun à travers ses restaurants, spas et espaces sensoriels. Le concept repose sur une immersion dans l'obscurité totale, où les repères habituels disparaissent pour laisser place aux autres sens et favoriser une nouvelle façon de vivre les échanges et les expériences.
Plébiscité par la presse et le grand public, le groupe est aujourd'hui présent dans 9 pays et 15 villes (Paris, Nantes, Bordeaux, Strasbourg, Toulouse, Marseille, Tours, Londres, Bruxelles, Lisbonne, Saint-Pétersbourg, Luxembourg, Genève, Mexico et Le Caire). Ses restaurants ont accueilli plus de 2,5 millions de visiteurs et font l'objet de près de 1 000 articles dans la presse internationale.
Ouvert en octobre 2021, le restaurant de Toulouse est né d'un partenariat avec l'hôtel 4 étoiles Pullman Toulouse Centre Ramblas, aujourd'hui devenu le FirstName Toulouse, situé sur les allées Jean-Jaurès.
Vos missions
Sous la responsabilité du « Project Manager » et en collaboration quotidienne avec lui, vous participerez au bon fonctionnement et au développement de Dans le Noir ? Toulouse. Vous pourrez également être en contact direct avec la Directrice du développement international de Dans le Noir ? pour des missions ponctuelles. description:
Who We Are
Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.
We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

About the Team
Our growth starts with reaching the right sellers and earning their trust. You'll join Growth & Marketing alongside Creative, CRM and Brand, and work in an acquisition squad with teammates from Product, Tech and Operations. A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role
As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.
Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT.

Zefir construit le pilote automatique IA de la vente immobilière en Europe, en commençant par la France. 🐻 Qui est Alan ?
En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons
Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec la médecine à distance et motivé(e)s à rejoindre notre service de chat médical - pour accompagner nos membres avec des conseils médicaux de qualité, mais aussi pour contribuer à la revue médicale de notre compagnon de santé.

ET Academy est la formation créée par Eva ----- 347 000 abonnés sur Instagram), créatrice de contenu voyage. Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres.
Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta.

Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes :
La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils.

Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence.

L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories.

Ads et acquisition payante
Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois.

Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA.

Tester chaque semaine de nouvelles créas et audiences, couper ce qui ne marche pas, scaler ce qui marche.

About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.
We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

summary: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make…
description:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret,…

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.

Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.

Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.

Everyday financial services : Avec helios by Younited, nous proposons des solutions pour aider chacun à mieux gérer ses finances, tout en construisant notre future offre bancaire du quotidien.

Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.

description:
Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder, outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle.
Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données.
L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants.
Les principales missions seront :
Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions.
Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés.
Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates).
Développer un moteur de…

You know SaaS. You like helping people get it right. And you'd rather have a real conversation than a hard sell.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Je haalt verhalen op bij collega's, klanten en partners en maakt daar inspirerende posts van

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment

Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories

Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance

Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness

Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About the team

The Incident Ops team is a global 24/7 team responsible for driving incident response and management from detection to resolution. Stripe is proud of its five 9s reliability and this team is at the forefront of ensuring we keep it that way - working hand-in-hand with Reliability Eng and across the Tech Org. Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.

Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Treasury for Platforms sits at the center of Stripe's evolution from a payments processor to a complete financial infrastructure provider. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and Treasury extends that mission by enabling marketplaces, software-as-a-service platforms, and fintechs to embed fully featured financial services directly into their own products.

By handling bank partnerships, compliance, and regulatory requirements, we allow platforms to launch quickly while focusing on the core parts of their business. We pair this with embedded user interfaces, managed support, and rich treasury features so our users can build great financial experiences.

Today, our platforms serve a highly diverse set of use cases, from payout cards for on-demand workers and operational accounts for in-field purchases to financial accounts for small businesses. We proudly power industry-leading products like Shopify Balance and Ambrook Wallet,…
